newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse buys Del Monte's Mexico unit.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse buys Del Monte's Mexico unit.

text.p: Investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc said on Wednesday that it has acquired Productos Del Monte SA de CV, the Mexico City based unit of Del Monte Foods.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Productos Del Monte holds Mexico's leading market share position in catsup, bottled salsa and canned corn and has annual sales of approximately $40 million, Hicks Muse said.
Hicks Muse said the deal reflects its interest in investing in Mexico and Latin America.
Hicks Muse is making the acquisition of Productos Del Monte with its C. Dean Metropoulous & Co food industry investment and management affiliate, the company said.
